subject: Renewal and right-sizing: EU node onboarding + APAC standby capacity
messages:
From: Emma Lang <emma.lang@healthgrid.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Singh <rajiv.s@healthgrid.com>, procurement@healthgrid.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning: EU onboarding + APAC standby ask

Hi Michael,

We’re starting renewal planning for HealthGrid’s contract (current term expires 2027-07-31). Two items are higher priority for next term:

1) EU node onboarding (production): we need EU residency for a subset of traffic and an onshore inference node with failover to US in case of incidents. Expected initial RPS ~120 (token mix similar to current profile).
2) APAC standby capacity (burst standby across Singapore nodes) — this would be cold standby that we can bring up for localized events; target 24/7 failover within 10 minutes.

Can you share a proposed amendment (term length options, unit pricing for dedicated EU node + standby hours for APAC) and an initial SOW estimate? We’re aiming to finalize commercial terms and tech onboarding by the end of June so we can lock a July go-live for the EU node.

I’ve attached our internal renewal worksheet for reference (HealthGrid_Renewal_Request_May2027.pdf). Procurement is looped for PO timing questions.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Lang
Head of Platform Products, HealthGrid

Emma —

Thanks for the clear ask and the worksheet — helpful. High-level response below and I attached a draft amendment (Redwood_Amendment_Draft_v1.docx) and a quick APAC standby sizing sheet (APAC_capacity_plan.xlsx).

Summary proposal (options):
- Term options: 12 months (standard renewal) or 24 months (preferred pricing).
- EU dedicated node: one reserved node (4xA10 equivalent) + deployment/onboarding SOW. Pricing: $XX,XXX/month for reserved capacity; one-time onboarding SOW $YY,XXX.
- APAC standby: standby pool with reserved minimal footprint + burst credits. Standby reserved baseline priced at $Z,XXX/month + burst invoiced by token-hours. 10-minute failover SLA included for customers on 24-month term or with dedicated standby commitment.

Technical notes:
- EU residency will be enforced at ingress and served from the EU node; cross-region KV cache warmup will be included in the SOW to reduce cold-start latency on failover.
- We recommend a staged failover test during the first 30 days post go-live (runbook and run-throughs included).

Next steps I propose:
1) Redwood prepares an amendment + SOW for the 24-month preferred pricing and a 12-month alternative.
2) We schedule a 30-minute technical sync next week with your infra and our Site Reliability team to confirm failover mechanics and key performance expectations.
3) I’ll include Marissa to confirm commercial terms and Ben to scope onboarding ops.

Are you available for a sync Wed 5/19 or Thu 5/20 (US time)?

Best,
Michael Grant
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 415-555-0104
